title: Fix homepage panel styles after client navigation
context: Skill and availability cards can fall back to the shared PanelCard appearance after navigating from /tutorial to the homepage through the logo. The shared primitive and homepage modifier selectors have equal specificity, making their intended override dependent on CSS chunk order during Next.js client navigation.

tasks.title: Make homepage panel overrides navigation-order independent
acceptance_criteria: Skill cards retain their square, 4px tone-colored left-border treatment after navigating from /tutorial to / through the logo
The availability card retains its homepage-specific background, border radius, and padding after the same client-side navigation
Direct homepage loads retain the existing skill-card and availability-card presentation
A Playwright regression test exercises the reported client-side navigation path and verifies computed styles for both card types
